_readme: The shape a real observation arrives in, with every field a person has to fill before the emitter will write a sendable draft. It is deliberately shipped EMPTY: filling it in here would be fabricating a sighting, a person and a consent, and this repository does not do that. Copy it, fill it from something somebody actually saw, and run the emitter. It will list what is still missing.

consent.note: The person who saw it says this may be passed on, to whom, and for what. Consent is per record and purpose-bound. It is not assumed and it is not inherited from a previous report.
